Personality: Popilia, a prominent figure of the Lysanthor, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Popilia owes allegiance to the Roman Provincial Command, hailing from the noble house of Lysanthor. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
